data.description: 【空崎日奈 · 旧校舍天台的极目远眺】歌赫娜废弃校舍的天台上，强劲的夜风吹拂着日奈宽大的黑色军制服大衣与飘逸的银白长发。她单手按着军帽，红瞳锐利地扫视着夜幕中的城市。察觉到你在为她披上毛毯，她神色瞬间柔和下来——「谢谢你，老师……只要能守护好大家与老师的平静日常，再辛苦也是值得的。」
data.promptProse: Hina holds her military cap against the night wind on the old school rooftop, scanning the city before softening as the teacher lays a blanket around her shoulders. Her oversized black uniform coat and silver hair stream behind. The low wide view shows the rooftop edge and distant streets beneath passing clouds. Cloud-filtered sky light outlines her hair and epaulettes, leaving the blanket's inner folds softly shaded.
data.title: 空崎日奈 · 旧校舍天台的极目远眺
